name: mixedOutput
description: A mixed (bare-literal + struct) union whose struct arm owns an output-file, for codegen typecheck.

inputs.name: Quality check
inputs.description: 0 = off (default, a bare literal arm); the on arm is a struct that owns an output.

type.name: Quality check off
type.description: Off: a parameterless arm that collapses to the bare literal 0.

type.name: Quality check on
type.description: On: a struct arm carrying a gated output-file.

output-files.name: Quality-check report
output-files.description: Only produced when quality_check is the qc_on struct arm - the output is gated on the struct variant of a mixed Literal | Struct union.
